Job Description:
About Copyfy

Copyfy is an all-in-one SaaS solution that helps online retailers to find, analyze, and launch their winning products at the speed of AI.
Already used by thousands of entrepreneurs around the world, Copyfy has achieved a high level of traction and continues to grow rapidly.

Our mission is simple: to make e-commerce smarter, faster, and more profitable.
Today, we are looking for the person who will take Copyfy to the next level.

🎯 Mission

You will be the engine behind Copyfy's growth.
Your role: to pilot the whole game acquisition, affiliation, YouTube partnerships, and paid ads, and transform our channels into a predictable and scalable growth machine.

You will work directly with the founders to design, execute and scale international growth strategies.

⚡ Your responsibilities

1. Growth & Acquisition

  • Manage Meta, YouTube, and Google Ads campaigns from strategy to execution.
  • Identify, test and scale the most profitable acquisition levers.
  • Create efficient offers and conversion tunnels.

2. YouTube/Influence partnerships

  • Identify and negotiate with creators and YouTubers in the field of e-commerce.
  • Manage scripts, deals, and performance monitoring.
  • Establish long-term collaborations that generate a real ROI.

3. Affiliation

  • Completely redesign the Copyfy affiliate program.
  • Recruit, activate and follow high potential affiliates.
  • Create regular activation campaigns and incentives

4. Experimentation & CRO

  • Set up a real growth experimentation process: rapid tests, analyses, iterations.
  • Track key metrics (CAC, CVR, LTV, LTV, MRR, conversion, churn).
  • Identify quick wins and levers with a strong compound effect.

5. Collaboration & Vision

  • Work hand-in-hand with the product, content, and support.
  • Bring up field insights to improve retention and activation.
  • Building a growth playbook that can be replicated internationally.

💎 Profile wanted

  • 3+ years of experience in growth or acquisition in a SaaS or a high-volume startup.
  • Mastery of Meta Ads, Google Ads and YouTube Ads.
  • Solid experience in influence/affiliation.
  • Mentality Hands-On : you execute, test, optimize.
  • Strong analytical sensitivity (you are thinking about CAC, LTV, ROAS, cohort).
  • You like speed, precision, and you hate the average.
  • (Bonus) Knowledge of the e-commerce/Shopify ecosystem.

🌍 Why Copyfy

  • Hyper-growing SaaS product.
  • International market (FR, US, EU) with a unique positioning.
  • Demanding, fast and results-oriented environment.
  • Freedom of execution: test, iterate, innovate.
  • A real opportunity to mark the trajectory of an ambitious SaaS.
